header.title: Data Deletion Instructions
header.subtitle: How to request deletion of your personal data from TenthMatrix

introduction.title: Introductie
introduction.content: TenthMatrix ("we," "us," or "our") respects your right to control your personal data. This page explains how to request deletion of data associated with your use of our websites, shop, and services — including accounts created or signed in with Facebook, Google, Apple, or email. It should be read together with our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 1. How to Request Data Deletion
sections.content: To request deletion of your personal data, use one of the methods below. We will verify your identity before processing the request.

subsections.subtitle: Email request (recommended)
subsections.content: Send an email to privacy@tenthmatrix.com with the subject line "Data Deletion Request". Include:
items: The email address associated with your account
The product or service you used (for example, Shop, website account, or Facebook Login)
Whether you want your entire account deleted or only specific categories of data
Any Facebook user ID or other identifier you know, if you signed in with Facebook

subsections.subtitle: Contact form
subsections.content: Submit a request via our Contact Us page and clearly state that you are requesting data deletion. Use the same email address tied to your account when possible.

subsections.subtitle: In-product account closure
subsections.content: On the shop account page (shop.workstation.co.uk/account), choose Deactivate account. Your account is scheduled to close automatically after 90 days. You can cancel the scheduled closure any time before then by signing in again or choosing Keep my account. After the close date we remove sign-in sessions, waitlist entries and unused credit for that email.

sections.title: 2. Facebook / Meta Login Users
sections.content: If you signed in to Workstation Shop or other TenthMatrix services using Facebook Login, you can request deletion of the data we received from Facebook and the account data we created for that sign-in.
items: **In the shop**: Sign in → Your account → Deactivate account (auto-closes after 90 days)
**From TenthMatrix**: Email privacy@tenthmatrix.com with subject "Facebook Data Deletion Request" and the email or Facebook name used at sign-in

**From Facebook**: Open Facebook Settings → Apps and Websites → find TenthMatrix → Remove. Removing the app from Facebook does not automatically delete data already stored by us — please also email us so we can complete deletion on our side
**What we delete**: Facebook user ID mapping, profile name/email received via Facebook Login (if stored), shop customer record linked to that login, and related session data
sections.recommendation: After we process your request, we will email a confirmation. Keep that confirmation for your records.

sections.title: 3. What We Delete
sections.content: When we approve a deletion request, we delete or anonymize personal data we hold about you, including where applicable:
items: Account profile information (name, email, phone, company)
Authentication identifiers (including OAuth provider IDs from Facebook, Google, or Apple)
Shop customer records, saved preferences, and chat follow-up emails tied to your account
Marketing subscription records (unless you ask us only to unsubscribe)
Support tickets and contact-form submissions linked to your identity, where legally permitted

sections.title: 4. What We May Retain
sections.content: Some information may be retained where we have a legal obligation or legitimate need:
details: **Financial and tax records**: Invoices and payment records may be retained for up to 7 years as required by law
**Security and fraud logs**: Limited logs may be retained for a reasonable period to prevent abuse
**Anonymized analytics**: Aggregated, non-identifying statistics may be retained
**Legal holds**: Data subject to an ongoing legal claim or regulatory inquiry may be retained until the matter is resolved
sections.disclaimer: Retained records are restricted to the purpose that requires retention and are not used for marketing.

sections.title: 5. Timeline
sections.content: We aim to acknowledge deletion requests within 7 days and complete deletion within 30 days of verifying your identity. Complex requests (for example, data spread across multiple products) may take longer; if so, we will tell you and keep you updated.
items: **Confirmation**: Email confirmation when deletion is complete

sections.title: 6. Related Rights
sections.content: Depending on your location, you may also have rights to access, correct, export, or restrict processing of your personal data. For a full list of rights and how we handle personal information, see our Privacy Policy.
sections.howToExercise: Contact privacy@tenthmatrix.com or dpo@tenthmatrix.com. We will respond within 30 days.

contact.title: 7. Contact Us
contact.content: For data deletion requests or questions about this process, contact us:

methods.label: Mail
methods.value: TenthMatrix, Data Protection Team, 77-79 Marlowes, Hemel Hempstead, Hertfordshire HP1 1LF, United Kingdom

acknowledgment.title: Acknowledgment
acknowledgment.content: Submitting a deletion request does not affect rights or obligations that must survive by law (for example, completed purchase records). If you have questions before requesting deletion, contact privacy@tenthmatrix.com.
